status: PROTOCOL AMENDMENT (execution order + futility only). All scientific gates unchanged. No training had started at amendment time.
within_seed_early_stopping: PROHIBITED. Every seed used for classification runs through step 1200. No seed is stopped early for any reason (good step-600 routing, needle 1.0, early prob>0.50, promising intermediate checkpoint, unlikely recovery).

reference_block.reason: A+ same-seed value is required by the causal-collapse threshold; every candidate must beat the COMPLETE frozen R0 reference

candidate_stage_rule.futility_rule: stop the arm immediately after its SECOND seed that is not CLEAN_STABLE (with two non-CLEAN_STABLE seeds, clean_stable>=4/5 is mathematically impossible)
candidate_stage_rule.success_rule: an arm SUCCEEDS only after ALL FIVE of its seeds have completed AND clean_stable_count >= 4/5 AND clean_stable_count > R0 clean_stable_count AND all mandatory quality/distance/integrity gates pass
candidate_stage_rule.no_four_seed_success: success is never declared from four completed seeds with the fifth unrun
candidate_stage_rule.on_success: select this candidate, STOP the intervention screen, do NOT run later candidates, do NOT run the O1 diagnostic

o1_diagnostic_branch.runs_only_when: O1R failed AND H1 failed AND H2 failed
o1_diagnostic_branch.purpose: determine whether the previously observed phenotype (routing forms near step 600, decays by 1200, needle may survive via causal impurity) appears on the reserved seeds
o1_diagnostic_branch.must_not: rescue or redefine a failed persistence intervention

run_count_bounds.note: savings come ONLY from omitting scientifically unnecessary later runs; never from weakening evidence

resume_behavior: the controller is a pure deterministic function of completed-seed results; resume = recompute the plan from persisted completed results; never reinterpret existing results
guardrails: deterministic decision tree, NOT outcome-driven tuning
futility boundary follows directly from the 4/5 success requirement
no success from fewer than five completed candidate seeds
later arms omitted only after an earlier arm has FULLY passed
an unrun arm is NOT_EVALUATED, never failed or inferior
selecting O1R first does not prove superiority to unrun H1/H2; only that O1R passed the frozen gate and later testing was unnecessary for this decision
